body:
**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `450c910`: all 54 files reviewed.

3 finding(s): 1 to fix, 2 to consider; 3 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 2.** Part 1 of 2: I reviewed all 38 files in this part and found no blockers. The new `exportDestination` field is checked against the known IDs in main before it is written and again when it is read back. The `recording-ready:show` handler now answers only the main window's renderer, which narrows who can float a card rather than widening it. `src/shared` adds only plain code and type imports, none from a workspace package. The new show-and-wait logic for the floating window settles correctly on ready, a newer card, a timeout, a failed load, a closed window and quit. Two findings, both in `use-floating-ready-card.ts`: the hook's JSDoc is now orphaned above the new `askedKeys` block (fix), and moving the asked-keys set to module scope means an in-app fallback card disappears when the page remounts on the same history entry (consider).

**Batch 2 of 2.** Part 2 holds tests, stylesheets, docs and messages, and it is in good shape. I checked that nothing still uses the removed i18n keys: `prepare.dropBody`, `export.barLabel`, `recordingReady.openHint`. The `barLabel` match in `capacity-card.tsx` belongs to another namespace. The new `importDropNoPath` and `railBadge` strings match the code and tests that use them. The test mocks of `useExportRunner` wrap the real hook correctly, and spying on `pathForFile` works because the test setup defines it. The doc rewrites match `use-prepare-import.ts` and `use-import-videos.ts`, with one small exception: after leaving Export, the Open action is offered only when a single video came in.

> ℹ️ No critical issues. Two small suggestions inline. One is the Email-tag fix, which stops short of two screens. **Reviewed changes** I reviewed all 24 commits: the review-comment fixes across the Export stack. - **Floating ready window**: `show()` now resolves only once the card has painted. It answers false on a failed load, a dead renderer or a 3 s timeout, and destroys that window. `recording-ready:show` refuses any sender but the main window. - **Floating card in the renderer**: the asked history keys are now kept module-wide, so Back does not float a second card. The in-app card drops Open. The floating card gets a shadow that fits its 16 px padding. - **Import queue**: a drop during a running import waits in a promise queue instead of being discarded. Videos with no path on disk get their own toast. Leaving Export mid-import shows a toast instead of navigating. - **Export screen**: it re-lists when a background copy lands and shows the loader only on the first load (the recording page too). The 1440p / 4K and Fill / Fit groups get arrow keys and a roving tabindex. The size card is plain text. Pick from Library is disabled while importing. The picker moves focus in and back out. - **Ready to upload cards**: only cards that were actually on screen (`shown`) retire on leaving the Library. Show in Finder or a drag (`actedOn`) forgets the copy then. Drag on the master page marks the copy seen. - **Destination in the sidecar**: `exportDestination` is written by the runner and persisted by `RecordingWriter`. `LibraryVault` reads it back, and `copyDestinationOf` prefers it. - **Accessibility and copy**: drag-only buttons leave the Tab order. The progress pill's name starts with its visible text. Unused i18n keys are removed, and the backlog docs are updated.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/471?action=fix&review_id=5722058892) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/471?action=fix-approved&review_id=5722058892) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41185870255/job/124492566125) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)

> ℹ️ The two new commits have no issues. My earlier comment on the Recent exports row and the master copies panel still stands. They still read an Email copy as chat. **Reviewed changes** This pass covers the two commits pushed since my last review. - **In-app fallback survives Back**: `use-floating-ready-card.ts` now records which history entries fell back in a module-wide `fellBackKeys` set, and `inApp` reads from it. A remount on the same entry shows the in-app card again without asking main twice. A new hook test covers this. The hook's JSDoc sits on the hook again, so I resolved that thread. - **Import doc wording**: `import-video.md` now says that after leaving Export mid-import, one video gets a toast with **Open** and several get a count. This matches `use-prepare-import.ts`.   ｜ [Fix it ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/471?action=fix&review_id=5722061812) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41185870255/job/124492566125) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)

> ✅ No new issues found. The new commit fixes the Email-tag gap I raised in my last review, so I resolved that thread. **Reviewed changes** This pass covers the one commit pushed since my last review, `54a08d37`. - **Recent exports reads the stored destination**: finished rows now call `copyDestinationOf(copy)` and fall back to the preset only when it returns null. An Email copy keeps its name and logo after it finishes. - **Master copies panel reads the stored destination**: `destinationName` and `CopyIcon` now take a `DestinationId`. Finished copies resolve it through `copyDestinationOf`, and the running row uses the job's `destination`. YouTube's 1440p / 4K suffix still comes from the preset. `CopyIcon` still shows the plain tile in exactly the cases it did before, because `copyDestinationOf` is null only when `copyPresetOf` is null. - **Tests**: new cases in `master-copies-panel.test.tsx` and `export-page.test.tsx` render a Balanced copy whose sidecar stores `destination: "email"`. They check that it is named Email and that no Slack label appears.   ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41186466055/job/124494288072) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
